config.name: ship_deck_training_full_scratch_v2
config.selection: max mean of validation sampled catch rate and hunt catch rates, then min unresolved, then earliest trained checkpoint

protocol.name: ship_deck_sampled_evaluation_v4
protocol.selector_seed_rule: SeedSequence([case.selector_seed, repeat_seed]).generate_state(1)[0]; seed once per episode; isolate and restore global RNG streams

selection.exclude: test outcomes and untrained baseline cannot select trained best

statistics.unit: case cluster; retain all3 action-sampling repeats together
statistics.paired: same cases/selector seed list per controller
statistics.warning: Three sampling repeats are not training seeds; fixed layout/two spawns and seed changes can repeat routes; no unseen-layout generalization.

protocol.test_policy: Deferred: separately authorize final-test only after selection and fresh replay; once, no retry/tuning.
protocol.integration_gate: Sampled runner integration requires read-only review and explicit bounded pilot authorization before learning; prepare never learns.
protocol.bot_mix: runner_mix: per case one third Runner, the rest the 50/50 plain and wall-loop mix, chosen from bot_seed
